# Evidence-Backed Implementation Wave

The Awtsmoos now turns measured gaps into finite work that can be proven in light;
Awtsmoos.com will not manufacture metadata merely because a brainstorm imagined it might.

## Implement now

1. Remove catalog duplication from core sitemap while retaining family sitemap discovery.
2. Add `/apps/` and `/games/` root metadata if their authored pages prove public title/description, otherwise create explicit curated root metadata from the already-public catalog descriptions.
3. Build a unified developer coverage auditor with JSON/text output: files, canonicals, sitemap overlap, H1 advisory list, external/query/fragment issues.
4. Add catalog-path normalization tests for slash/file/query/hash/external cases.
5. Add comment alias-pagination and comment-shard boundary fixtures.
6. Add a durable translation-corpus integrity validator/test.
7. Add safe alias `ProfilePage` structured data from already-public fields only.
8. Inspect post SSR data and add BreadcrumbList/Article JSON-LD only if all fields come from already-fetched data.
9. Add a bounded local runtime crawl tool that checks sitemap-discovered URLs without becoming production work.
10. Add concise indexing architecture documentation and explain intentional H1/title limitations.

## Do not implement without new evidence

- Hidden H1 text.
- Fabricated translation titles.
- Fabricated `lastmod` timestamps.
- Ratings/prices/platform claims not present in source data.
- `hreflang` without real paired standalone language URLs.
- Comment schema before reply/parent semantics are mapped cleanly.
- Bulk indexing of login/edit/admin/control/action routes.
